body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 14, 2026
USD stablecoin market cap has jumped 30% (+$71B) to roughly $308B, even as Tether's USDT supply shrank ~$4B over the past 60 days.
Stablecoin News
Tether Says KPMG Completed Its First Full Audit
Tether announced KPMG finished an independent audit of its financial statements for the first time, though it hasn't released the report publicly.
Circle Launches cirBTC, a Regulated Wrapped Bitcoin
Circle debuted cirBTC, a 1:1 BTC-backed token custodied under its OCC-supervised trust bank, verified via Chainlink Proof of Reserve.
Circle Shares Slide on Revenue Miss
Circle stock posted its worst day in months on Aug 12 after a revenue miss, though analysts still see upside as stablecoin volumes hit record highs.
TRM Labs Traces $6.3B Through Sanctioned Shelbit Network
Investigators tracked $6.3B moving through Shelbit following OFAC sanctions on Aug 7, with 88% flowing as dollar stablecoins on Tron.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Crypto Whale Loses $25.6M in Repeat Wallet Hack
An attacker drained a whale's wallet of wBTC, cbBTC, LDO and CRV on Aug 13, converting proceeds to DAI and ETH; the same address was hit in 2023.
Coldcard Hardware Wallet Exploit Damage Reaches $130M
A five-year-old firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard device has been exploited since July 30, draining over 5,200 addresses across four waves.
Coinsbuy Hit by $7.9M Crypto Hack
Exchange Coinsbuy reported a $7.9M breach, with attackers laundering stolen funds into Monero, part of a wider 2026 theft spree topping $972M.
Two Separate Hacks Drain Over $51M via Key Compromises
A pair of incidents tied to compromised private keys resulted in a combined $51M+ in losses, underscoring persistent key-management risks.
